top_picks.use_for: Enterable houses and shops: walls, floors, stairs, doors, windows, roofs.
top_picks.why: Interior-capable kit at character scale (contents from memory); best candidate for climbable, breakable interiors.

assets_world.recommendation: Go (a): clean stylised low/mid-poly under full PBR lighting. Only this has complete, coherent, CC0, script-downloadable coverage (Quaternius MegaKits + Kenney + KayKit, whose authors also supply matching characters and animals). (b) semi-realistic fails on coverage: Poly Haven/ambientCG/Megascans give superb CC0 surfaces, skies and street props but 13 building models, one car and film-res trees (0.3-17M tris); realistic vehicles and people would mean login-gated, brand-risky CC BY Sketchfab uploads. (c) voxel: almost no clean free city content (MMMM, CC BY 4.0, miniature) and it echoes the rejected box prototype; if voxel destruction wins anyway, voxelise these same kits. Use photoreal CC0 PBR only as material: fracture interiors, strata, roads, decals, HDRI light. Unify: 1) one master shader on all man-made meshes: albedo only, roughness/metal per material class, world-space triplanar detail at one texel density (about 512 px/m) so fragments never stretch; 2) script-remap kit atlases to one 48-64 colour palette and tint 1K-2K PBR sets to it; 3) 1 unit = 1 m, 3 m storeys (Kenney/KayKit are toy scale); 4) one sun/sky rig and one grade. Fracture: no free kit is solid. Modular, break per module and pre-fracture offline into closed chunks with an interior material slot: Quaternius Downtown, Kenney Modular Buildings and Building Kit, Poly Haven facades. Single hollow shells, for skyline/LOD or swap to a procedural solid core on first hit: Kenney City Kit Commercial/Suburban/Industrial, KayKit City Builder Bits. Generate slabs, columns, rebar, roads and strata procedurally. Blender (free, headless) is justified for convert, rescale, decimate and Cell Fracture.
license_traps: CC BY-NC, BY-NC-SA, BY-NC-ND (common on Sketchfab, e.g. the popular 'Fantasy Interior Kit' is CC BY-NC): unusable in a sold game, no matter how the asset is modified.

CC BY-ND: modified versions may not be distributed. Fracturing, retexturing, decimating or palette-remapping are modifications, so ND assets are unusable in this game even though commercial use is allowed.
CC BY-SA and GPL art (OpenGameArt, some Sketchfab): share-alike attaches to the adapted asset; avoid for anything you modify and ship in a closed commercial build.
'Editorial' licences: Sketchfab Editorial, CGTrader Editorial, TurboSquid 'Editorial Uses Only' (TurboSquid text explicitly lists video games as excluded). Typical for branded cars, aircraft, logos.

Sketchfab 'Free Standard' is a store licence, not Creative Commons. Top 'modular city' search hits use it ('Neighbourhood City Modular lowpoly', 'Full Gameready City Buildings IV [HongKong]', 'Hong Kong Monster building Modular Low Poly LOD'). Do not treat as CC0/CC BY; no redistribution of files.

Sketchfab licences are self-declared. Expect ripped game models, real-brand vehicles and AI-generated meshes under CC BY/CC0; check uploader history, description and tags. AI-generated assets have uncertain copyright and would have to be declared in Steam's AI content disclosure (Steam policy from memory).

Trademarks and designs are not covered by any CC licence: real car makes, 'Liebherr tower crane', 'Boeing 747', national-rail liveries, military insignia, brand logos on billboards. Prefer fictional vehicles (Kenney, Quaternius) and remove logos.

Fab/Megascans: Megascans obtained under the old free-with-Unreal entitlement were Unreal-only; re-acquire under the Fab Standard License. Listings under the legacy 'UE Marketplace' licence (Epic Content License Agreement) and Epic-authored sample content can be Unreal-only. Many free Fab packs ship only Unreal .uasset files.

Fab Standard License, BlenderKit Royalty Free, CGTrader and TurboSquid licences all forbid standalone redistribution: raw asset files must never be pushed to a public Git repo or shipped as loose, extractable files.

CGTrader and TurboSquid require the asset to be embedded in a proprietary, non-extractable form. A default Godot .pck is trivially unpacked: either enable PCK encryption or do not use these sources. CGTrader also bans ML use of free downloads.

ShareTextures now calls its terms 'Custom CC0 ... with specific restrictions': 'No use in hateful, violent, or illegal content' and 'No automated downloads'. Risky for a destruction game that harms human NPCs, and not scriptable.
FreePBR is no longer free for commercial use: free only 'As long as you don't use these commercially'; commercial licence costs $19.
Free3D and many itch.io/CGTrader freebies carry 'personal use' licences or no licence at all. 'Free' is a price, not a licence: require an explicit licence line on the author's own page.

Poly Pizza bundles mix CC0 and CC BY 3.0 per model (City Pack: 18 CC0 / 39 CC BY; Office Pack: 42 / 85). Record licence per model. CC BY needs title, author, source link, licence link and a note that the model was modified: generate a CREDITS file automatically from day one.

Take Kenney, Quaternius and KayKit assets only from the authors' own pages or their mirrors on Poly Pizza/GitHub. Re-uploads by third parties on Sketchfab, Fab, Unity Asset Store or CGTrader may claim different licences.

Quaternius and KayKit paid tiers (Source, Pro, Extra) are also CC0 but are not free; with a zero budget do not pull them from third-party mirrors. The Godot shaders and fake interiors live only in those tiers.
NASA models are free of copyright, but the NASA insignia and logotype are 'not in the public domain' and no endorsement may be implied: strip logos from textures.
Poly Haven and ambientCG assets are CC0, but Poly Haven's website content is not and site scraping needs permission: use the official API with a unique User-Agent. Kenney: do not use the Kenney logo.
